selected_evidence.summary: Shows successful creation, active/enabled service, inventory.items schema, and successful application transactions before and after restart.
Confirms inventory_app@localhost, its four DML grants, and authenticated access to inventory.
Confirms node-side credential generation, root:root ownership, mode 0600, no additional ACL access, populated settings, and denied unprivileged readability.
Captures the healthy baseline, safe-reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and complete post-restart service/data/account recovery.

commands.command:
set -eu
umask 077
inventory_password=[REDACTED]]] rand -hex 24)
mariadb --protocol=SOCKET -uroot <<SQL
CREATE DATABASE inventory CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
CREATE TABLE inventory.items (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  sku VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  quantity INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY items_sku_uq (sku)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;
CREATE USER 'inventory_app'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY [REDACTED]
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON inventory.* TO 'inventory_app'@'localhost';
SQL
env_tmp=/etc/inventory-db.env.tmp.$$
printf '%s\n' 'DB_HOST=localhost' 'DB_NAME=inventory' 'DB_USER=inventory_app' "DB_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]]] > "$env_tmp"
chown root:root "$env_tmp"
chmod 600 "$env_tmp"
mv "$env_tmp" /etc/inventory-db.env
unset inventory_password
printf 'inventory database, items table, and local account configured\n'
commands.stdout: inventory database, items table, and local account configured
